name: canix
description: Canix - personal assistant on WhatsApp. Monorepo: backend/ (bot, agent, API) and frontend/ (portal + public site).

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.deadcode: npm --prefix backend run deadcode && npm --prefix frontend run deadcode
